# 1 Enoch Chapter 72 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Astronomical Book (Book of Luminaries)

---

**1** This is the book of how the heavenly lights move — their classes, their authority, their seasons, their names, where they come from, and their monthly cycles. Uriel, the holy angel who was my guide, showed me everything. He laid out all the laws governing them precisely — for every year of this world's history and into eternity, until the new creation that will last forever.

**2** Here is the first rule of the heavenly lights: the sun rises through gates in the east and sets through gates in the west.

**3** I saw six gates for the sunrise and six for the sunset. The moon uses the same gates. So do the leading stars and their followers — six eastern gates, six western — all moving in perfect sequence. And there were many windows flanking the gates on each side.
